expectations.text: The normal sequence is authorize, import, review mappings, Start sync after all mapped; import alone does not start sync.
expectations.evidence: Four steps preserve authorize, import, review mappings, then Start sync once all rows mapped; explicitly says product import alone does not start order sync.

expectations.text: It gives Mapping status location, Mapped/Unmatched conditions, and Link item or inventory-lead remedy only for Unmatched rows.
expectations.evidence: Step 3 locates Mapping status in Connections > Products and separates ready Mapped rows from Unmatched rows requiring Link item or lead creation before linking.

expectations.text: Disconnect/reimport and Reauthorize are clearly conditional on wrong shop and Authorization expired respectively, not universal prerequisites.
expectations.evidence: Wrong-shop paragraph conditions Disconnect/authorize/reimport on Connections > Account showing the wrong shop; Reauthorize is stated to be needed only for Authorization expired.
